house_style: Painterly realistic illustration, like a cinematic matte painting or concept art for an animated film: believable light, depth and atmosphere, rich detail everywhere so any part can be cropped into a nice photo. No text, no letters, no signs with words, no watermark, no border.

assets.name: harbor
assets.prompt: A wide view of a small fishing harbor on a calm sunny morning. A long straight wooden pier starts at the bottom-center foreground and runs into the distance toward a white and red lighthouse standing on a rocky point at the right-middle. The flat sea horizon runs straight across. A few small colorful boats moored, gulls, soft clouds, cottages on a green hill at the left.

assets.name: street
assets.prompt: A wide eye-level view down a straight old European city street with tram tracks running from the bottom foreground to a vanishing point near the middle. Shops with awnings, potted plants, balconies, warm stone buildings. On the left side a big stone archway frames a sunny little courtyard with a fountain. A person in a red coat rides a bicycle toward the right in the middle distance. Late afternoon sun.

assets.name: lake
assets.prompt: A wide mountain lake valley in early autumn: snowy peaks behind, a still lake with mirror reflections across the middle, a single golden tree on a small grassy rise near the right, a winding dirt path making an S-curve from the bottom left foreground to the tree. A hiker in a yellow jacket walks on the path. Wildflowers in the foreground.
